key.name: deepseek-api-key
key.description: Bearer token for the DeepSeek balance endpoint. Stored as plaintext in dconf — the same trade-off as any GNOME extension storing credentials.

key.name: deepseek-enabled
key.description: Whether Price Track Buddy polls the DeepSeek account.

key.name: deepseek-base-url
key.description: Leave empty for https://api.deepseek.com

key.name: deepseek-currency
key.description: ISO 4217 code such as CNY or USD. Empty uses the first balance entry the API returns.

key.name: openrouter-api-key
key.description: Bearer token for the OpenRouter credits endpoint. A management key is required. Stored as plaintext in dconf.

key.name: openrouter-enabled
key.description: Whether Price Track Buddy polls the OpenRouter account.

key.name: openrouter-base-url
key.description: Leave empty for https://openrouter.ai/api/v1

key.name: custom-enabled
key.description: Show and poll the user-supplied custom endpoint.

key.name: custom-name
key.description: Name shown on the card and in the indicator menu. Empty uses "Custom endpoint".

key.name: custom-url
key.description: Full URL returning JSON with a numeric total (or balance).

key.name: custom-api-key
key.description: Bearer token or custom-header value. Stored as plaintext in dconf.

key.name: custom-auth-mode
key.description: One of bearer, header, none. Bearer sends Authorization: Bearer <key>.

key.name: custom-auth-header
key.description: Header used when the authentication mode is header.

key.name: custom-currency
key.description: Used when the endpoint's JSON omits currency.

key.name: custom2-enabled
key.description: Show and poll the second user-supplied endpoint.

key.name: custom2-name
key.description: Name shown on the card and in the indicator menu. Empty uses "Custom endpoint 2".

key.name: custom2-url
key.description: Full URL returning JSON with a numeric total (or balance).

key.name: custom2-api-key
key.description: Bearer token or custom-header value. Stored as plaintext in dconf.

key.name: custom2-auth-mode
key.description: One of bearer, header, none.

key.name: custom2-auth-header
key.summary: Second custom endpoint auth header name
key.description: Header used when the authentication mode is header.

key.name: custom2-currency
key.description: Used when the endpoint's JSON omits currency.

key.name: custom3-enabled
key.description: Show and poll the third user-supplied endpoint.

key.name: custom3-name
key.description: Name shown on the card and in the indicator menu. Empty uses "Custom endpoint 3".

key.name: custom3-url
key.description: Full URL returning JSON with a numeric total (or balance).

key.name: custom3-api-key
key.description: Bearer token or custom-header value. Stored as plaintext in dconf.

key.name: custom3-auth-mode
key.description: One of bearer, header, none.

key.name: custom3-auth-header
key.summary: Third custom endpoint auth header name
key.description: Header used when the authentication mode is header.

key.name: custom3-currency
key.description: Used when the endpoint's JSON omits currency.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often the panel re-reads both provider balances.

key.name: visible
key.description: Master switch for the floating panel. Use the top-bar indicator to bring it back after closing.

key.name: collapsed
key.summary: Collapse the widget to a compact chip

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Adds a small indicator with a menu (show/hide widget, refresh, settings).

key.name: opacity
key.description: Overall opacity of the floating panel, from 20% (very translucent) to 100% (opaque).

key.name: always-on-top
key.summary: Keep the widget above fullscreen windows
key.description: When enabled the floating panel stays visible on top of fullscreen applications. When disabled, a fullscreen window on the same monitor covers it.

key.name: position-x
key.description: -1 anchors the widget to the bottom-right edge of the primary monitor.

key.name: position-y
key.description: -1 anchors the widget to the bottom-right edge of the primary monitor.
